jain-university.about: Promoted by JAIN Group, the university is recognized among the top universities in India and considered a preferred learner-centric destination for students from different countries across the globe. Known for its emphasis on education, entrepreneurship, research and sports, JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) has some of the best minds in the educational and research fields, and centres that inspire entrepreneurship and innovative thinking.
highlights: Our M.Sc. in Computer Science and IT programme emphasises data mining, programming, and software development, equipping students to meet the needs of the IT sector.
Focus on hands-on activities and experiments gives students valuable experience in real-world applications.
The Master of Science programme provides students the opportunity to participate in industry visits, workshops, and seminars that allow students to stay informed about current industry trends.
We focus on holistic development, promoting critical thinking and problem-solving abilities alongside technical knowledge.
Internship opportunities allow students to gain practical experience, which prepares them for the workforce.
Students have 100% placement assistance and can take advantage of on-campus placement opportunities in the thriving IT industry aided by the Master of Science degree.
NAAC rates JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) A++ grade with a CGPA of 3.71 on a four-point scale

viteee-registration.about: VITEEE Registration 2026 (Started): Check Application Link Here Fill in your details to get instant alerts & expert guidance.
highlights: VITEEE 2026 registration has started from 24th October 2025.
Before proceeding towards registration, candidates must fulfill the complete eligibility criteria.
After registration, fill the form by adding the personal details, academic qualification, communication information, etc.
Now upload the scanned documents in prescribed format & size.
In case of any mistake made in the registration form, candidates will be able to rectify the mistake during the correction window via online mode.
Rs. 1350/- is the application fee for VITEEE 2026 exam.

General Category candidates require a minimum of 60% in PCM (Physics/Chemistry/Mathematics) or PCB (Physics/Chemistry/Biology) in their Class 12th. For SC/ST & Northeastern states, a minimum of 50% is required.
Candidates must have completed Class 12 or an equivalent qualification from recognized boards, including GCE A-level, IB Diploma, or the National Institute of Open Schooling.

viteee-slot-booking.about: VITEEE 2026 slot booking — get alerts, link & reminders. Slot booking windows can be short — keep your login details handy.
highlights: First-come, first-served : preferred cities/sessions can fill quickly.
Portal-driven : options shown in your dashboard are the source of truth.
Open the official VITEEE portal and log in with your application credentials (application number + password/OTP as applicable).
Go to the Slot Booking section in your dashboard.
Review details carefully, then confirm your slot. Take a screenshot/print of the confirmation page.
After confirmation, check for the Hall Ticket option (availability timing may vary). Download when it appears.
Want reminders when the window opens? Fill the Get Updates form — we’ll share alerts and key steps.
Login details : application number and password/OTP access.
